_comment: Tier-2: for the free-surface TwoFluid solver the level-set DISTANCE variable must be initialised before the first solve and re-distanced every step. Pitfall (kratos.fluid #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). DISTANCE resolves on core KratosMultiphysics and not on FluidDynamicsApplication. Its nodal default is 0.0 — an uninitialised DISTANCE field puts the zero level set through every node at once, which is the degenerate interface the claim's 'spurious zero-crossings inside the bulk fluid' describes, and nothing raises. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
